environments_parent_shape_check.name: environments_parent_shape_check
environments_parent_shape_check.value:
(
        (
          "environments"."parent_environment_id" IS NULL
          AND "environments"."parent_base_commit" IS NULL
          AND "environments"."parent_had_uncommitted_changes" = 0
        )
        OR
        (
          "environments"."parent_environment_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "environments"."parent_base_commit" IS NOT NULL
          AND "environments"."managed" = 1
          AND "environments"."workspace_provision_type" = 'managed-worktree'
        )
      )

events_scope_shape_check.name: events_scope_shape_check
events_scope_shape_check.value:
(
        ("events"."scope_kind" = 'turn' AND "events"."turn_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("events"."scope_kind" = 'thread' AND "events"."turn_id" IS NULL)
      )

project_sources_shape_check.name: project_sources_shape_check

session_fabric_bindings_open_thread_idx.name: session_fabric_bindings_open_thread_idx
session_fabric_bindings_open_thread_idx.where: "session_fabric_execution_bindings"."thread_id" IS NOT NULL AND "session_fabric_execution_bindings"."closed_at" IS NULL
